exposure: etiology of obstetric hemorrhage: postpartum, placenta accreta, postpartum hysterectomy
mode of delivery: caesarean section, spontaneous vaginal delivery
finding: Combined management, including surgical hemostasis and insertion of vaginal and uterine balloon of Zhukovsky, reduced blood loss by 1.5 times and the number of hysterectomies by 6.72 times compared to controls.
mod_finding: Among women experiencing obstetric hemorrhage, the insertion of a Zhukovsky double balloon was performed in 70.7% of those who delivered via caesarean section and 29.3% of those who delivered via spontaneous vaginal delivery.
